caption: ChatGPT through MCP. Send work from your coding client and get code, analysis and images back.
A local bridge connects your MCP client, a durable SQLite queue and your saved ChatGPT browser session.
Actual captured TypeScript output. This recorded run completed in 10.6 seconds; timing varies. Waiting is shortened.
An actual image generated through Wrapper. Image delivery includes a local file and chat display/download links.
Six development task types: code generation, code review, reasoning, image generation, image analysis and image editing. Provider UI availability varies.
Local fixture benchmark: median queue, validation and persistence improved from 244 to 1.7 milliseconds. Twelve samples; browser and provider time excluded.
Build from source at github.com/rnaefe/chatgpt-wrapper. Requires Node.js 24 and your ChatGPT account. Sign-in and provider verification remain manual.
